subject: John Intoppa Candidacy for School Committee
overview: School Committee candidate John Intoppa discussed his platform for the 2023 election, focusing on student-centered governance, safety, and mental health resources. Intoppa detailed how his background as a student leader and university trustee informs his approach to supporting Medford Public Schools.

items.title: Candidate Introduction and Community Ties
items.summary: John Intoppa introduced his background as a Medford native and former student trustee at the Massachusetts College of Art and Design.

items.title: Motivation and Past Experience
items.summary: Intoppa explained his decision to run for School Committee again, reflecting on how his experience in university governance prepared him for the role.

items.title: Student Advocacy and Safety
items.summary: The candidate advocated for centering the student voice in school committee decisions, particularly regarding school safety protocols and violence response.

items.title: Framework for Student Experience
items.summary: Intoppa described student experience as a framework for providing students with the guided autonomy and safety necessary to focus on learning and growth.

items.title: Curriculum and Educational Exposure
items.summary: Discussion addressed the need for curriculum transparency and increasing student exposure to diverse perspectives, mental health topics, and the arts.

items.title: Vision and Campaign Kickoff
items.summary: Intoppa shared his vision for implementing JEDI principles and supporting student leadership programs while announcing a campaign kickoff event for October 8.
